Dear Harish Singhania,

Answer using only these facts; offer to walk them through the details.

Question: Will the bootcamp also cover Kotlin, or only block-based apps?
Facts:
  • Program: Hands-on app-building bootcamp for classes 5–9; block-based apps for juniors, Kotlin introduction for seniors on days 5-7
  • syllabus v2: # 7-day syllabus
Block-based apps days 1-4 for classes 5-7; Kotlin basics days 5-7 for classes 8-9 in the computer lab.


Warm regards,
Akash Rathore
YuviPep
